message: Outdated Apache version vulnerable to path traversal and remote code execution.
action: Upgrade Apache immediately to version 2.4.51 or higher.
Upgrade OpenSSH to the latest stable release.
Audit FTP daemon and upgrade to a secure, patched version of vsftpd.

message: Outdated Nginx web server version detected.
action: Upgrade Nginx to the latest stable release to patch known security flaws.

message: Potentially vulnerable or exposed Redis server version detected.
action: Ensure Redis requires authentication (requirepass) and is not exposed directly to the public internet.

message: End-of-life or legacy MySQL version detected.
action: Upgrade MySQL to version 8.0 or higher.
